case.court: Supreme Court of the United States
case.limits: Warhol v. Goldsmith later narrowed how far transformative purpose reaches, holding that the first factor asks whether the new use shares the original's purpose, particularly when both are licensed into the same market.
case.holding: A commercial parody can be fair use. The Court made transformative purpose the centre of the first fair use factor and rejected the idea that commercial use is presumptively unfair.
case.why_ai_cites_it: This is the case that put the word transformative into the middle of American fair use, and nearly every AI training defense is built on the claim that learning statistical relationships from a work is a transformative purpose rather than a substitute for it.
